versions.content: The PduR shall use the apiServicePrefix attribute of the CDD's vendor specific module definition ( EcucModuleDef element) to replace the <Lo> , <Up> , and <LoTp> tags of the GenericComServices APIs . The CDD's ven- dor specific module definition can be indirectly accessed via the configuration param- eter PduRBswModuleRef which references the top-level element of the concrete con- figuration of the CDD (i.e., EcucModuleConfigurationValues element) which ref- erences the CDD's vendor specific module definition ( EcucModuleDef element ).
